title: uPAR PET/CT for Preoperative Staging of Breast Cancer Patients
brief_summary: The sensitivity and specificity of uPAR PET/CT for preoperative detection of lymph node metastases in breast cancer.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Biopsy-verified breast cancer
* Primary tumor more than 2 cm (ultrasound or clinically)
* The participants must be capable of understanding and giving full informed written consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Lactation/breast feeding
* Weight above 140 kg
* Treatment with neoadjuvant chemotherapy
* Known allergy towards the IMP
